# Data Loading
```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
set.seed(42)
Diabetes_path <- "../data/D003924_phyloseq_updated_species.RData"
ps <- get(load(Diabetes_path))
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps_pa  <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
```

# Sample Filtering
```{r filter-samples}
sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")

samples_to_keep <- sd %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  filter(if_all(c("Nr..reads.sequenced", "Host.age"), ~!is.na(.))) %>%
  filter(Sex %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
  pull(SampleID)

cat("Samples kept:", length(samples_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Samples removed:", nsamples(ps) - length(samples_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Country distribution:\n")
print(table(sd[samples_to_keep, "Country"]))
```

# Build Phyloseq Objects
```{r build-phyloseq, include=FALSE}
sample_data(ps)$keep <- sample_names(ps) %in% samples_to_keep
ps_clean <- subset_samples(ps, keep == TRUE)
sample_data(ps_clean)$keep <- NULL
sample_data(ps)$keep <- NULL
ps_clean <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_clean) > 0, ps_clean)

# Add readable labels
sample_data(ps_clean)$Disease <- ifelse(
  sample_data(ps_clean)$Disease.MESH.ID == "D003924", "T2D", "Healthy"
)
sample_data(ps_clean)$Continent <- case_when(
  sample_data(ps_clean)$Country == "China" ~ "Asia",
  TRUE ~ "Europe"
)

# Transformations
ps_rel_cleaned <- transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps_pa_cleaned  <- transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
ps_clr <- microbiome::transform(
  transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) x + 1),  # add pseudocount first
  transform = "clr"
)

# Subsets
ps_t2d        <- subset_samples(ps_clean, Disease == "T2D")
ps_t2d_female <- subset_samples(ps_t2d, Sex == "Female")
ps_clr_female <- microbiome::transform(
  transform_sample_counts(ps_t2d_female, function(x) x + 1),  # add pseudocount first
  transform = "clr"
)
bray_dist_t2d    <- distance(ps_t2d_female, method = "bray")
meta_df      <- sample_data(ps_t2d_female) %>% data.frame()
meta_df_join <- meta_df %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID")

cat("T2D samples by continent:\n")
print(table(sample_data(ps_t2d)$Continent))
cat("T2D female samples by continent:\n")
print(table(sample_data(ps_t2d_female)$Continent))
```

# Distances

```{r distances, include=FALSE}
bray_dist    <- distance(ps_rel_cleaned, method = "bray")
jaccard_dist <- distance(ps_pa_cleaned,  method = "jaccard")
```

# Alpha Diversity
```{r alpha-diversity}
alpha_div <- estimate_richness(ps_clean, measures = "Shannon") %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    as(sample_data(ps_clean), "data.frame") %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

wilcox.test(Shannon ~ Sex, data = alpha_div)
kruskal.test(Shannon ~ Country, data = alpha_div)
cor.test(alpha_div$Shannon, alpha_div$Host.age, method = "spearman")
```

## RDA
```{r rda-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
# ── Change dataset here ──────────────────────────────────────────────
rda_data <- ps_t2d_female
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 1. CLR-transformed OTU matrix
rda_clr <- microbiome::transform(rda_data, "clr")
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_table(rda_clr))
if (taxa_are_rows(rda_clr)) otu_clr <- t(otu_clr)
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_clr)

# 2. Metadata
meta_rda <- sample_data(rda_data) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  select(Continent, Host.age, Nr..reads.sequenced) %>%
  mutate(
    Host.age            = scale(Host.age),
    Nr..reads.sequenced = scale(Nr..reads.sequenced),
    Continent           = as.factor(Continent)
  )

# 3. RDA
rda_result <- rda(otu_clr ~ Continent + Host.age + Nr..reads.sequenced,
                  data = meta_rda)

# 4. Variance explained
eig  <- rda_result$CCA$eig
pct1 <- round(eig[1] / rda_result$tot.chi * 100, 1)
pct2 <- round(eig[2] / rda_result$tot.chi * 100, 1)

# 5. Site scores + metadata
site_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    sample_data(rda_data) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# 6a. Biplot arrows
biplot_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "bp") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

site_range  <- max(abs(c(site_scores$RDA1, site_scores$RDA2)))
arrow_scale <- site_range * 0.8 /
  max(sqrt(biplot_scores$RDA1^2 + biplot_scores$RDA2^2))
biplot_scores <- biplot_scores %>%
  mutate(RDA1 = RDA1 * arrow_scale, RDA2 = RDA2 * arrow_scale)

# 6b. Top species scores
tax_df <- tax_table(rda_data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  mutate(across(-taxon, ~str_remove(., "^[a-z]__")))

species_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "species") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "taxon") %>%
  mutate(label = Species)

top_species <- species_scores %>%
  mutate(importance = sqrt(RDA1^2 + RDA2^2)) %>%
  slice_max(importance, n = 10)

species_scale <- site_range * 0.6 /
  max(sqrt(top_species$RDA1^2 + top_species$RDA2^2))
top_species <- top_species %>%
  mutate(RDA1 = RDA1 * species_scale, RDA2 = RDA2 * species_scale)

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, color = Continent),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = biplot_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = biplot_scores,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 1.15, y = RDA2 * 1.15, label = variable),
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = top_species,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = top_species,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 1.15, y = RDA2 * 1.15, label = label),
            size = 2.5, color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Asia" = "#E74C3C", "Europe" = "#3498DB")) +
  labs(
    title = "RDA: gut microbiome constrained by Continent, Age & Read depth",
    x = paste0("RDA1 (", pct1, "% of total variance)"),
    y = paste0("RDA2 (", pct2, "% of total variance)"),
    color = "Continent"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# PERMANOVA & Dispersion
```{r extract-sample-metadata}
sample_df <- sample_data(ps_t2d_female) %>% data.frame()

```

```{r permanova-bray}
adonis_res <- adonis2(
  bray_dist_t2d ~ Continent + Host.age + Nr..reads.sequenced,
  data = sample_df,
  permutations = 999
)

adonis_res
```

```{r dispersion-test}
dispersion_bray <- betadisper(
  bray_dist_t2d,
  sample_df$Continent
)

permutest(dispersion_bray, permutations = 999)
plot(dispersion_bray)
```

```{r}
adonis_df <- as.data.frame(adonis_res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  filter(!term %in% c("Total", "Residual"))

adonis_df <- adonis_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.01  ~ "**",
      `Pr(>F)` < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

ggplot(
  adonis_df,
  aes(x = reorder(term, R2), y = R2)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3498DB") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sig),
    hjust = -0.2
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  expand_limits(y = max(adonis_df$R2) * 1.1) +
  labs(
    title = "PERMANOVA variance explained",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(R^2)
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ord <- ordinate(
  rda_data,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = "bray"
)

continent_p <- adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
continent_r2 <- adonis_res$R2[1]

plot_ordination(
  rda_data,
  ord,
  color = "Continent"
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "PCoA (Bray-Curtis)\n",
      "PERMANOVA: p = ",
      signif(continent_p, 3),
      ", R² = ",
      round(continent_r2, 3)
    )
  )
```
```{r build-clr-long}
rank_depth <- "Species"

# CLR matrix from already-computed phyloseq object
otu_clr_lm <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_clr_female))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_clr_female)) otu_clr_lm <- t(otu_clr_lm)
otu_clr_lm <- as.data.frame(otu_clr_lm)

clr_long <- otu_clr_lm %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -SampleID,
    names_to = "taxon",
    values_to = "clr"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_df_join, by = "SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    tax_df %>% select(taxon, all_of(rank_depth)),
    by = "taxon"
  )
```


# Differential Abundance
```{r continent-differential, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
effect_threshold <- 0.01

lm_results <- clr_long %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(rank_depth))) %>%
  do(
    tidy(
      lm(
        clr ~ Continent + Host.age + Nr..reads.sequenced,
        data = .
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(term == "ContinentEurope") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    significant = p_adj < 0.05,
    practical = abs(estimate) >= effect_threshold,
    significant_practical = significant & practical
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

ggplot(
  lm_results,
  aes(
    x = estimate,
    y = -log10(p_adj),
    color = significant_practical
  )
) + geom_rect(
  aes(xmin = -effect_threshold, xmax = effect_threshold,
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "grey80",
  alpha = 0.2
) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lm_results %>%
      filter(significant) %>%
      slice_max(abs(estimate), n = 15),
    aes(label = .data[[rank_depth]]),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    "FALSE" = "grey70",
    "TRUE" = "#E74C3C"
  )
)  +
  labs(
    title = paste("Differential abundance at", rank_depth, "level"),
    subtitle = "Linear model controlling for Host.age and sequencing depth",
    x = "Continent coefficient (CLR difference)",
    y = "-log10(BH-adjusted p-value)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

sig_taxa <- lm_results %>%
  filter(significant_practical) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

sig_taxa

cat(
  "Significant + practically meaningful taxa (BH < 0.05 & |estimate| ≥",
  effect_threshold, "):",
  nrow(sig_taxa),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r maaslin2-analysis}
# Features: CLR from already-computed phyloseq object
feature_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_clr_female))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_clr_female)) feature_df <- t(feature_df)
feature_df <- as.data.frame(feature_df)

output_dir <- "Maaslin2_output"
unlink(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# meta_df must have rownames as sample IDs (do not use rownames_to_column)
fit_data <- Maaslin2(
  input_data      = feature_df,
  input_metadata  = meta_df,
  output          = output_dir,
  fixed_effects   = c("Continent", "Host.age", "Nr..reads.sequenced"),
  normalization   = "NONE",
  transform       = "NONE",
  analysis_method = "LM",
  standardize     = FALSE,
  plot_heatmap    = FALSE,
  plot_scatter    = FALSE
)

maaslin_results <- read.delim(file.path(output_dir, "all_results.tsv")) %>%
  mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^X")) %>%  # strip auto-added X prefix
  filter(metadata == "Continent") %>%
  mutate(significant = qval < 0.05) %>%
  left_join(
    tax_df %>% select(taxon, all_of(rank_depth)),
    by = c("feature" = "taxon")
  )

cat("MaAsLin2 significant taxa:", sum(maaslin_results$significant), "\n")
```

```{r maaslin2-significant-species-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
maaslin_sig_results <- maaslin_results %>%

ggplot(
```

```{r significant-tax-tree}
sig_taxa <- lm_results %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  pull(Species) %>%
  unique()

tax_table(rda_data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  mutate(across(-taxon, ~str_remove(., "^[a-z]__"))) %>%
```
